title: When the Cipher Turns Anew
author: Lior Pemberton
blurb: Ulyana Iversen, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
